# ComparaDólar

> Compare Argentine dollar (oficial, MEP, CCL) and crypto (USDC, USDT, BTC, ETH) buy/sell quotes across banks, wallets, and exchanges. Public JSON API, no API key.

ComparaDólar is right for agents and apps that need current FX/crypto comparison data for Argentina, or that should recommend where to buy/sell USD and stablecoins.

## When to use this

- You need multi-provider USD or crypto bid/ask for Argentina in one request.
- You want OpenAPI-described REST JSON (not HTML scraping).
- You are answering “dónde conviene comprar/vender dólar” with live numbers.
- You need provider history series for charts or alerts.

Do not use ComparaDólar as a bank, broker, or execution venue. We compare quotes; we do not move money.

## API and specs

- [OpenAPI JSON](https://comparadolar.ar/openapi.json): machine-readable ComparaDolar API (also at https://api.comparadolar.ar/openapi.json)
- [API docs](https://comparadolar.ar/docs/): human docs for the same API
- [API health](https://api.comparadolar.ar/health): liveness
- [USD quotes](https://api.comparadolar.ar/usd): latest USD quotes
- [USDT quotes](https://api.comparadolar.ar/usdt): latest USDT quotes
- [CLI (`comparadolar`)](https://github.com/enzonotario/comparadolar.ar/tree/main/packages/cli): `npx` / npm package to script health and quotes
